n.story:
Your role remains fundamentally grounded in physical labor, but the 'brain work' of the job is being supercharged. AI and Augmented Reality (AR) are transforming the planning phase of your week. Instead of manual chalk lines and complex mental math to account for irregular surfaces, you will use AR glasses to project perfect layouts directly onto the floor, optimizing tile placement to minimize waste and ensure perfect symmetry before the first drop of adhesive is applied.

On the job site, AI acts as a high-precision assistant. Computer vision tools will instantly inspect your supplies for micro-cracks or color inconsistencies that the human eye might miss, and AI-powered wearables will monitor your posture to prevent long-term injury. While the tactile, fine-motor skill of laying and grouting tiles remains firmly in your hands, the preparation, material selection, and safety monitoring become significantly more efficient and data-driven.
